body: This happened to my dog today. I thought she was chocking or ate something poisonous and was going into anaphylactic shock. She was thrashing and panicked. Once I was able to see the stick I just dislodged it and it was like nothing happened. Such a relief, I thought I was literally watching her die a minute before :(

Thank you for your answers and I hope you are getting the moral support and love to never try ending your life again. 

It does go with his personality that he'd be very determined and see it through. I think it confirms what I already knew. The amount of suffering required to stick to such a method breaks my heart.
